        model.parameters(),
        lr=5.0e-4,
        weight_decay=2e-4,
    )
    optimizer.tail_average_start = max(1, int(0.90 * total_steps))
    optimizer.tail_average_count = 0
    optimizer.tail_average_parameters = [
        parameter.detach().clone()
        for parameter in model.parameters()
        if parameter.requires_grad
    ]
    return optimizer
